title: SpatialMem: Metric-Aligned Long-Horizon Video Memory for Language Grounding and QA
abstract: arXiv:2601.14895v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: SpatialMem is a memory-based system which integrates 3D geometry, semantics, and language with one another in one combined, queryable representation. Starting with casually recorded egocentric RGB video, SpatialMem recreates metrically scaled interior scenes, recognizes structural 3D anchors (walls, doors, windows) as the first-layer scaffold, and associates open-vocabulary object nodes with evidence patches, visual embeddings, and two-layer descriptions to 3D coordinates, enabling spatial-relation reasoning, language-directed retrieval, and QA without special sensors. We test at scale on public benchmarks. On VSI-Bench ($288$ videos, $5{,}130$ questions) SpatialMem scores $37.5$ overall with RGB alone, and its margin is precisely where a metric memory should earn it (room size $41.4$ vs.\ $24.4$ with a same-size frame model). translated_title: SpatialMem：面向语言接地与问答的度量对齐长时程视频记忆
translated_abstract: SpatialMem 是一个基于记忆的系统，它将三维几何、语义与语言整合到一个统一且可查询的表示中。以随意拍摄的第一人称视角 RGB 视频作为输入，SpatialMem 重建出具有度量尺度的室内场景，将结构性三维锚点（墙壁、门、窗）识别为第一层支架，并将开放词汇的对象节点与证据图像块、视觉嵌入以及两层描述关联到三维坐标上，从而在无需特殊传感器的情况下实现空间关系推理、语言引导检索和问答。我们在公开基准上进行了大规模测试。在 VSI-Bench（288 个视频、5,130 个问题）上，仅使用 RGB 的 SpatialMem 总分达到 37.5，且其优势恰恰体现在度量记忆应当发挥价值的地方（在房间大小任务上为 41.4，而同等规模的帧级模型仅为 24.4）。在 OpenEQA 的情景记忆任务（953 个问题）上，序列化为文本的记忆低于 t……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SpatialMem 仅凭随手拍摄的第一人称 RGB 视频，即可构建融合三维几何、语义与语言的度量级可查询记忆，无需特殊传感器就能完成空间关系推理、语言引导检索与长时程视频问答，并在 VSI-Bench 和 OpenEQA 等基准上取得领先表现。
en_tdlr: SpatialMem turns casually captured egocentric RGB video into a metrically scaled, queryable memory unifying 3D geometry, semantics, and language, enabling spatial-relation reasoning, language-guided retrieval, and long-horizon QA without special sensors.
